title: Smart Visual Ear Cleaner with 1080P HD Wireless Endoscope Camera

ai_insight.viral_factor: The 1080P wireless endoscope camera streams live gross-out macro footage of earwax removal straight to the viewer's phone, triggering intense satisfying curiosity that hooks viewers instantly.
ai_insight.compliance_notes: Avoid making explicit medical or diagnostic claims (e.g., curing infections or medical-grade cleaning). Include standard disclaimers that this is for personal hygiene use only to prevent ad platform rejections.
ai_insight.recommended_hook_angle: Start with an extreme close-up of a massive earwax plug under the 1080P scope with the text 'I can't believe lived with this inside my ear' to instantly captivate curiosity in the first 3 seconds.
ai_insight.target_audience: Gen Z and Millennials interested in satisfying ASMR content, gadgets, and personal hygiene products looking for a dopamine-boosting cleaning experience.

title: Levitating Magnetic Astronaut Galaxy Aurora Projector with 360 Rotation

ai_insight.viral_factor: The mesmerizing combination of a floating magnetic astronaut head projecting a spinning galaxy aurora across dark bedroom walls creates an immediate sensory spectacle. In 숏폼 videos, the visual contrast in a pitch-black room instantly stops scrolling.
ai_insight.compliance_notes: Ensure standard CE/FCC safety certifications are verified for the USB power supply and magnetic base to prevent overheating risks. Avoid making any false astronomical or medical claims regarding sleep healing.
ai_insight.recommended_hook_angle: Start the video in pitch darkness with the caption 'POV: You turned your bedroom into a private galaxy,' then instantly snap the magnetic astronaut head onto the base to reveal the swirling aurora ceiling.
ai_insight.target_audience: Gen Z and young adults aged 15-28 looking for aesthetic room decor, aesthetic lighting, and ambient bedroom upgrades for TikTok and Twitch setups.

title: Mini Pocket Thermal Photo & Note Printer with Inkless Bluetooth Printing

ai_insight.viral_factor: Instantly printing sticky notes or mini polaroid-style photos directly from a smartphone via Bluetooth without any ink creates a mesmerizing, tactile 'magic' reveal that hooks viewers in the first seconds.
ai_insight.compliance_notes: Ensure advertising clearly states it prints monochrome thermal paper only (no color photos) to avoid misleading consumer claims, and verify CE/RoHS battery safety compliance for electronic imports.
ai_insight.recommended_hook_angle: Start the video with a messy, chaotic study desk or disorganized planner, then slap a freshly printed aesthetic checklist or cute mini-photo onto it within 2 seconds while text overlays read 'The TikTok gadget that cured my ADHD/procrastination.'
ai_insight.target_audience: Gen Z students, journal/planner enthusiasts, and busy young professionals looking for aesthetic, affordable organizational tools and creative DIY room decor.

title: Mini Portable Electric Air Duster & Vacuum 2-in-1 for Keyboard & Car

ai_insight.viral_factor: The satisfying transformation of deeply dusty, crumb-filled keyboards and car crevices instantly blasted clean into a spotless state creates an addictive before-and-after visual loop that triggers ASMR-like viewing behavior on short-form feeds.
ai_insight.compliance_notes: Ensure all lithium-ion battery advertising claims comply with local platform safety standards and clearly state that it is a generic high-power cleaner without referencing copyrighted brand names.
ai_insight.recommended_hook_angle: Start by zooming in on a brutally filthy, hair- and crumb-covered mechanical keyboard, then slam the air duster down and blast it clean in one explosive second with the text overlay: 'Stop destroying your $200 keyboard with canned air.'
ai_insight.target_audience: Tech enthusiasts, PC gamers, and car detailers aged 18-35 looking for satisfying, portable gadget solutions to maintain their workspace and vehicle hygiene.

title: Automatic Stirring Magnetic Mug for Coffee & Milk

ai_insight.viral_factor: The mesmerizing self-stirring vortex effect creates a satisfying ASMR visual when milk and coffee swirl together without a spoon, perfect for looping TikTok and Shorts feeds.
ai_insight.compliance_notes: Ensure clear disclaimers regarding battery safety (waterproof compartment integrity) and avoid exaggerated durability or medical health claims.
ai_insight.recommended_hook_angle: Start with a close-up of powder and milk being poured into the mug, then press the button to reveal the magical self-stirring vortex with zero spoon noise.
ai_insight.target_audience: Busy office workers, coffee enthusiasts, and lazy college students looking for novelty kitchen gadgets and aesthetic desk accessories.
